Prashant Bhushan Calls for Regime Change, Accuses BJP of Hypocrisy

Lawyer and activist Prashant Bhushan stated that he and others "want regime change" and that it is a "constitutional right." He accused the BJP of hypocrisy, alleging that the party aims to erase evidence of past "wrongdoing." Actor Prakash Raj also alleged that the BJP seeks to erase evidence of past wrongdoing. Bhushan's remarks were framed as an "open dare" to the government.
